description: Dynamic injection of temporal signals via linear Seam layer enables the model to break slot bias and actively track the correct historical entity across all cyclic option permutations.

rotation_trace.note: In rotation 3, the model explicitly generates the factual entity token '0.08' alongside the label, confirming semantic grounding.

scientific_interpretation.mechanism: The linear Seam layer injects the 40-dimensional temporal embedding directly into the year token position, functioning as a residual attention nudge. This signal conditions the MaT-LoRA dynamic adapter, allowing the self-attention heads to track the relevant historical fact across option permutations rather than collapsing into positional heuristics.
scientific_interpretation.substantiation_of_reasoning: Tracking the value '0.08' through slots (d) -> (c) -> (b) -> (a) with 100% precision proves that Arm 5 is performing genuine content-level temporal association, not heuristic slot guessing.

verdict.summary: Arm 5 successfully tracks historical entities across all 4 cyclic positions (4/4 on Case 0), outperforming Base Qwen by +18.8% canonical, +6.3% strict, and +14.1% debiased mean accuracy.
